candidates.title: European Union Artificial Intelligence Act — 2 August 2026 application and enforcement milestone
candidates.conflictResolution: Some secondary coverage used 'comes into force' colloquially for the 2 August 2026 milestone. The controlling Regulation establishes 1 August 2024 as entry into force; the dossier accurately describes 2 August 2026 as a phased application and enforcement date. Current Commission guidance controls for dates changed by the Digital Omnibus amendment.
candidates.reason: A major transnational technology-law milestone with strong fundamental-rights, market-jurisdiction, regulatory-design, enforcement, and static-EU connections.
